fixes: Home desktop: Remove redundant tier legend under total balance and integrate into bar tooltip

fixes: Receipt modal: Increase background dim opacity to 80% for better modal focus

overall.verdict: The desktop-dark variant demonstrates strong fintech product design with excellent hierarchy, premium aesthetics, and clear data visualization. The visceral value bars effectively communicate financial positions, and trust elements are well-implemented. Minor improvements could enhance readability and interactivity.

Improve QR code contrast in receive screen
Enhance modal focus in receipt screen
Add better interactivity feedback to activity list
